chapter.heading: Ezekiel 7
The Day of the Wrath of the LORD
chapter.v: 7 The word of the Lord came to me:
“And you,O son of man, thus says the Lord God to the land of Israel:An end! The end has come upon the four corners of the land.
Nowthe end is upon you, andI will send my anger upon you; I will judge you according to your ways, and I will punish you for all your abominations.
And my eye will not spare you, nor will I have pity, butI will punish you for your ways, while your abominations are in your midst. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
after disaster! Behold, it comes.
An end has come; the end has come; it has awakened against you. Behold, it comes.
Your doom has come to you, O inhabitant of the land. The time has come; the day is near, a day of tumult, and not of joyful shouting on the mountains.
and judge you according to your ways, and I will punish you for all your abominations.
Then you will know that I am the Lord , who strikes.
the rod has blossomed; pride has budded.
None of them shall remain, nor their abundance, nor their wealth; neither shall there be preeminence among them.
for wrath is upon all their multitude.
For the vision concerns all their multitude; it shall not turn back; and because of his iniquity, none can maintain his life.
for my wrath is upon all their multitude.
and him who is in the city famine and pestilence devour.
doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, each one over his iniquity.
All hands are feeble, and all knees turn to water.
baldness on all their heads.
the stumbling block of their iniquity.
I make it an unclean thing to them.
they shall profane it.
and profane it.
and the city is full of violence.
and their holy places shall be profaned.
they will seek peace, but there shall be none.
counsel from the elders.
and they shall know that I am the Lord .”
